title: PAN: A World Model for General, Actionable, and Long-Horizon World Simulation
abstract: arXiv:2511.09057v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: A world model is a cognitive simulator of the real-world environment allowing biological agents to reason about how the world evolves, whether spontaneously or in response to their actions, and accordingly to plan and strategize. In building Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems, world models represent the next frontier beyond large language models (LLMs) to enable physical and embodied intelligence in AI agents, allowing them to perform decision-making through simulative reasoning and reinforcement-learning through simulative trials. Recent advancements in world modeling have yielded impressive progress in video generation, 3-D scene evolution, robotic dynamics, and game simulation, but limitations persist in general, open-domain, action-driven prediction, long-horizon consistency, and abstract reasoning and planning. translated_title: PAN：面向通用、可交互、长时程世界模拟的世界模型
translated_abstract: 世界模型是对真实世界环境的认知模拟器，使生物智能体能够推理世界如何演化——无论是自发演化还是在自身行动的响应下演化——并据此进行规划与策略制定。在构建人工智能（AI）系统方面，世界模型代表着超越大语言模型（LLM）的下一个前沿方向，旨在赋予AI智能体物理智能与具身智能，使其能够通过模拟推理进行决策制定，并通过模拟试验进行强化学习。世界建模领域的最新进展在视频生成、三维场景演化、机器人动力学和游戏模拟等方面取得了令人瞩目的成果，但在通用的、开放域的、行动驱动的预测、长时程一致性，以及抽象推理与规划方面仍存在局限。此外，还存在着一些根本性的架构问题，例如状态表示、信息流或训练……
tldr: 该论文提出了PAN——一个通用、可行动交互且具备长时程一致性的世界模型，旨在突破现有世界模型在开放域行动驱动预测和抽象推理规划方面的局限，推动AI实现超越大语言模型的物理与具身智能。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces PAN, a general, actionable, and long-horizon consistent world model designed to overcome existing limitations in open-domain action-driven prediction and abstract reasoning/planning, advancing AI beyond LLMs toward physical and embodied intelligence.
